estimates.assumptions: 2 large Romano peppers estimated at 130g each (edible flesh after deseeding; typical weight for large pointed peppers is 100-150g).
3 tablespoons red pepper paste (biber salcasi) at ~15g per tablespoon, typical for thick pastes; modest calorie density based on concentrated roasted peppers.
1 tablespoon pul biber (Turkish chili flakes) at ~6g per tablespoon; calorie density typical for dried spice flakes.
